question: Twitter dashboard's winning filter (within 10% of 52wk high + 3-month momentum > 30%): among 4%-days already within 10% of the 52-week high, does bigger 3-month momentum grade better -- expect higher ret_63 = better
plain: A shared backtest dashboard claims 'within 10 percent of the 52-week high plus a 30 percent 3-month run' is the best swing entry filter; both legs failed alone on our data, so this tests the combination -- momentum ranked inside the near-high subset.
